title: pm-dispatch text: lanes become seats plus epics, the domain seats retire, and area leases only guard file overlap (step 4a)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing gate: child of epic #35205, filed by seat 1. Ruling-ref: the maintainer said 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z) to the fleet skills review and its order of improvements (summary https://claude.ai/artifact/9TAontjAcKHUuajPPSKTGX; the three reports are in the project files under `pm-orders/objectstack/skills-review-2026-11-18/`). ⛔ Not a claim.

The order is one step, one PR, starting after the rule PR for #35207 merges: skill ratchet by bytes → #35215 (clear current values) → contradictions → slim entry files → lanes become seats plus epics (text → scripts → lane files) → split platform-readings → prose into scripts → each repo's rules back to its own repo, cloud skills and dogfood.

Blocked-by: #35231

## What to do

Step 4a, in the skill TEXT only. Lanes become two kinds: **seats** and **epics**. The domain seats `server`, `spec`, `ui`, `devx` and `skills` retire. Area leases stay, but only to stop two developers editing the same files at once. A lease no longer decides which card a seat takes. Cards are picked by epic and area under the grade rules.

Scripts still read `domain:*` until step 4b, so this PR changes no script behaviour. It says so where a script is named.

## Done when

The skill text describes seats plus epics. No retired domain seat is named as live, and the lease text says the lease only guards overlapping files.
